SELECT 'STG_EDS_DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE', COUNT(*), CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS_OF_DATE FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE WHERE H='D' GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE',COUNT(*),AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE


SELECT *  FROM EDS.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE
